sourceContext.originPage: Tongariro Alpine Crossing booking form page

contentPattern.structure: definition-driven form: headings + radio choice groups (some conditional) + number/date/text/tel/email inputs + statistical questions + submit button
fieldGroups: own vehicle (radio Yes/No, conditional plate-number + other)
statistical questions (residency, hike experience, transport, optional survey opt-in)

suitableFor: multi-question data-collection forms driven by a form definition source
pages needing radio groups, number/date/text/email fields and a submit endpoint
notSuitableFor: static content that an author can simply type
pages with a single inline search input (use the search block)

authoringModel.rows: 2-row single-column table: row 1 = block name; row 2 = link to the form definition source (spreadsheet/JSON of fields) plus the submit/action URL
authoringModel.note: Renders fields from a form definition source via form-fields.js (text, number, date, email, tel, radio, checkbox, select, fieldset, plaintext/heading, submit). New variant of the canonical AEM Edge Delivery form block; the forms-excat plugin/skill was not available so it was created via the standard block-variant workflow.
